name: GitHub code review
description: Review labeled pull-request heads, publish readable findings, and record exact-head test and review decisions.

github.message: Used to choose repositories during setup; the selected profile supplies the runtime credential.

exampleImplementation: A scheduled scanner selects every labeled PR head and submits an idempotent subject turn. The profile-backed agent clones that exact head in its runtime, reuses the established review workflow, runs appropriate tests, publishes a readable native review, and records exact-head review and test statuses.

schedule.label: Check frequency
schedule.help: How often to look for newly labelled pull requests.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.help: Timezone the schedule is interpreted in.

repositories.label: Repositories
repositories.help: Repositories to scan. Labeled pull-request heads are reviewed independently.

triggerLabel.label: Trigger label
triggerLabel.help: Only pull requests carrying this label are reviewed.

reviewTone.label: Review tone
reviewTone.help: How detailed the review comments should be.

githubTokenSecret.label: GitHub token secret
githubTokenSecret.help: Name of a saved secret allowed by the selected agent profile. Enter its name, not its value.

setup.message: Configure the repositories, review label, tone, credential name, agent profile, and schedule.
